services_pricing_shape.name: services_pricing_shape
services_pricing_shape.value:
("services"."pricing_kind" = 'fixed' and "services"."base_price_minor" is not null and "services"."base_price_minor" > 0)
          or ("services"."pricing_kind" = 'inspection' and "services"."base_price_minor" is null)

addresses_text_lengths.name: addresses_text_lengths
addresses_text_lengths.value:
length(btrim("addresses"."formatted_address")) between 1 and 300
        and ("addresses"."label" is null or length(btrim("addresses"."label")) between 1 and 40)
        and ("addresses"."building" is null or length(btrim("addresses"."building")) between 1 and 40)
        and ("addresses"."entrance" is null or length(btrim("addresses"."entrance")) between 1 and 40)
        and ("addresses"."floor" is null or length(btrim("addresses"."floor")) between 1 and 40)
        and ("addresses"."apartment" is null or length(btrim("addresses"."apartment")) between 1 and 40)
        and ("addresses"."landmark_note" is null or length(btrim("addresses"."landmark_note")) between 1 and 300)

addresses_position_on_earth.name: addresses_position_on_earth
addresses_position_on_earth.value: ST_X("addresses"."position") between -180 and 180 and ST_Y("addresses"."position") between -90 and 90

masters_bio_length.name: masters_bio_length
masters_bio_length.value: "masters"."bio" is null or length(btrim("masters"."bio")) between 1 and 600

admin_audit_log_reason_length.name: admin_audit_log_reason_length
admin_audit_log_reason_length.value: "admin_audit_log"."reason" is null or length(btrim("admin_audit_log"."reason")) between 1 and 600

admin_users_email_shape.name: admin_users_email_shape
admin_users_email_shape.value: length("admin_users"."email") between 3 and 320 and position('@' in "admin_users"."email") > 1

admin_users_last_totp_step_needs_enrolme.name: admin_users_last_totp_step_needs_enrolment
admin_users_last_totp_step_needs_enrolme.value: "admin_users"."last_totp_step" is null or "admin_users"."totp_enrolled_at" is not null

master_documents_lifecycle_shape.name: master_documents_lifecycle_shape
master_documents_lifecycle_shape.value:
("master_documents"."status" = 'awaiting_upload'
             and "master_documents"."submitted_at" is null
             and "master_documents"."size_bytes" is null
             and "master_documents"."verified_content_type" is null)
          or ("master_documents"."status" <> 'awaiting_upload'
             and "master_documents"."submitted_at" is not null
             and "master_documents"."size_bytes" is not null
             and "master_documents"."verified_content_type" is not null)

master_documents_review_shape.name: master_documents_review_shape
master_documents_review_shape.value:
("master_documents"."status" in ('accepted', 'rejected'))
          = ("master_documents"."reviewed_by_admin_id" is not null and "master_documents"."reviewed_at" is not null)

master_verification_history_actor_shape.name: master_verification_history_actor_shape
master_verification_history_actor_shape.value:
("master_verification_history"."actor_kind" = 'master') = ("master_verification_history"."actor_user_id" is not null)
          and ("master_verification_history"."actor_kind" = 'admin') = ("master_verification_history"."actor_admin_id" is not null)

order_status_history_actor_shape.name: order_status_history_actor_shape
order_status_history_actor_shape.value:
("order_status_history"."actor_kind" in ('customer', 'master')) = ("order_status_history"."actor_user_id" is not null)
          and ("order_status_history"."actor_kind" = 'admin') = ("order_status_history"."actor_admin_id" is not null)

orders_price_requires_master.name: orders_price_requires_master
orders_price_requires_master.value: "orders"."price_minor" is null or "orders"."master_id" is not null

orders_accepted_at_requires_master.name: orders_accepted_at_requires_master
orders_accepted_at_requires_master.value: "orders"."accepted_at" is null or "orders"."master_id" is not null

orders_arrival_promise_shape.name: orders_arrival_promise_shape
orders_arrival_promise_shape.value:
("orders"."promised_arrival_at" is null) = ("orders"."arrival_promise_source" is null)
          and ("orders"."promised_arrival_at" is null or "orders"."accepted_at" is not null)

order_photos_sanitize_pending_idx.name: order_photos_sanitize_pending_idx
order_photos_sanitize_pending_idx.where: "order_photos"."status" <> 'awaiting_upload' and "order_photos"."sanitized_at" is null and "order_photos"."sanitize_failure" is null

order_photos_lifecycle_shape.name: order_photos_lifecycle_shape
order_photos_lifecycle_shape.value:
("order_photos"."status" = 'awaiting_upload'
             and "order_photos"."submitted_at" is null
             and "order_photos"."size_bytes" is null
             and "order_photos"."verified_content_type" is null
             and "order_photos"."order_id" is null
             and "order_photos"."attached_at" is null)
          or ("order_photos"."status" = 'confirmed'
             and "order_photos"."submitted_at" is not null
             and "order_photos"."size_bytes" is not null
             and "order_photos"."verified_content_type" is not null
             and "order_photos"."order_id" is null
             and "order_photos"."attached_at" is null)
          or ("order_photos"."status" = 'attached'
             and "order_photos"."submitted_at" is not null
             and "order_photos"."size_bytes" is not null
             and "order_photos"."verified_content_type" is not null
             and "order_photos"."order_id" is not null
             and "order_photos"."attached_at" is not null)

order_photos_sanitize_shape.name: order_photos_sanitize_shape
order_photos_sanitize_shape.value:
("order_photos"."sanitized_at" is null and "order_photos"."sanitize_failure" is null)
          or ("order_photos"."status" <> 'awaiting_upload'
             and (("order_photos"."sanitized_at" is not null
                   and "order_photos"."sanitize_failure" is null
                   and "order_photos"."sanitized_key" = "order_photos"."storage_key")
                  or ("order_photos"."sanitized_at" is null and "order_photos"."sanitize_failure" is not null)))

master_locations_position_on_earth.name: master_locations_position_on_earth
master_locations_position_on_earth.value: ST_X("master_locations"."position") between -180 and 180 and ST_Y("master_locations"."position") between -90 and 90

message_attachments_lifecycle_shape.name: message_attachments_lifecycle_shape
message_attachments_lifecycle_shape.value:
("message_attachments"."status" = 'awaiting_upload'
             and "message_attachments"."submitted_at" is null
             and "message_attachments"."size_bytes" is null
             and "message_attachments"."verified_content_type" is null
             and "message_attachments"."message_id" is null
             and "message_attachments"."attached_at" is null)
          or ("message_attachments"."status" = 'confirmed'
             and "message_attachments"."submitted_at" is not null
             and "message_attachments"."size_bytes" is not null
             and "message_attachments"."verified_content_type" is not null
             and "message_attachments"."message_id" is null
             and "message_attachments"."attached_at" is null)
          or ("message_attachments"."status" = 'attached'
             and "message_attachments"."submitted_at" is not null
             and "message_attachments"."size_bytes" is not null
             and "message_attachments"."verified_content_type" is not null
             and "message_attachments"."message_id" is not null
             and "message_attachments"."attached_at" is not null)

message_attachments_sanitize_shape.name: message_attachments_sanitize_shape
message_attachments_sanitize_shape.value:
("message_attachments"."sanitized_at" is null and "message_attachments"."sanitize_failure" is null)
          or ("message_attachments"."status" <> 'awaiting_upload'
             and (("message_attachments"."sanitized_at" is not null
                   and "message_attachments"."sanitize_failure" is null
                   and "message_attachments"."sanitized_key" = "message_attachments"."storage_key")
                  or ("message_attachments"."sanitized_at" is null
                      and "message_attachments"."sanitize_failure" is not null
                      and "message_attachments"."message_id" is null)))

calls_end_matches_status.name: calls_end_matches_status
calls_end_matches_status.value: ("calls"."status" in ('RINGING', 'ACCEPTED')) = ("calls"."ended_at" is null and "calls"."end_reason" is null)

calls_answer_matches_status.name: calls_answer_matches_status
calls_answer_matches_status.value:
("calls"."status" = 'ACCEPTED' and "calls"."answered_at" is not null)
          or ("calls"."status" = 'ENDED')
          or ("calls"."status" not in ('ACCEPTED', 'ENDED') and "calls"."answered_at" is null)

calls_timestamps_ordered.name: calls_timestamps_ordered
calls_timestamps_ordered.value:
("calls"."answered_at" is null or "calls"."answered_at" >= "calls"."started_at")
          and ("calls"."ended_at" is null or "calls"."ended_at" >= "calls"."started_at")

reviews_about_master_idx.name: reviews_about_master_idx
reviews_about_master_idx.where: "reviews"."author_role" = 'customer' and "reviews"."revealed_at" is not null and "reviews"."removed_at" is null

reviews_about_customer_idx.name: reviews_about_customer_idx
reviews_about_customer_idx.where: "reviews"."author_role" = 'master' and "reviews"."revealed_at" is not null and "reviews"."removed_at" is null

reviews_removal_complete.name: reviews_removal_complete
reviews_removal_complete.value:
("reviews"."removed_at" is null) = ("reviews"."removed_by_admin_id" is null)
          and ("reviews"."removed_at" is null) = ("reviews"."removal_reason" is null)

reviews_removal_reason_length.name: reviews_removal_reason_length
reviews_removal_reason_length.value: "reviews"."removal_reason" is null or length(btrim("reviews"."removal_reason")) between 1 and 600

subscription_events_payment_shape.name: subscription_events_payment_shape
subscription_events_payment_shape.value:
("subscription_events"."price_id" is null) = ("subscription_events"."amount_minor" is null)
          and ("subscription_events"."price_id" is null) = ("subscription_events"."payment_ref" is null)

subscription_checkouts_kind_shape.name: subscription_checkouts_kind_shape
subscription_checkouts_kind_shape.value:
case "subscription_checkouts"."kind"
            when 'hosted' then "subscription_checkouts"."checkout_url" is not null
                           and "subscription_checkouts"."renews_period_end" is null
                           and "subscription_checkouts"."payment_method_id" is null
            else "subscription_checkouts"."checkout_url" is null
                 and not "subscription_checkouts"."save_card"
                 and "subscription_checkouts"."renews_period_end" is not null
                 and "subscription_checkouts"."payment_method_id" is not null
          end

subscription_payments_amount_shape.name: subscription_payments_amount_shape
subscription_payments_amount_shape.value:
("subscription_payments"."amount_minor" is null) = ("subscription_payments"."currency" is null)
          and ("subscription_payments"."amount_minor" is null or "subscription_payments"."amount_minor" >= 0)

reports_text_length.name: reports_text_length
reports_text_length.value: "reports"."text" is null or length(btrim("reports"."text")) between 1 and 1000

reports_outcome_reason_length.name: reports_outcome_reason_length
reports_outcome_reason_length.value: "reports"."outcome_reason" is null or length(btrim("reports"."outcome_reason")) between 1 and 600

reports_status_shape.name: reports_status_shape
reports_status_shape.value:
case "reports"."status"
            when 'open' then "reports"."handled_by_admin_id" is null and "reports"."outcome" is null and "reports"."closed_at" is null
            when 'in_review' then "reports"."handled_by_admin_id" is not null and "reports"."claimed_at" is not null and "reports"."outcome" is null and "reports"."closed_at" is null
            else "reports"."handled_by_admin_id" is not null and "reports"."outcome" is not null and "reports"."outcome_reason" is not null and "reports"."closed_at" is not null
          end

master_avatar_uploads_renditions_live_id.name: master_avatar_uploads_renditions_live_idx
master_avatar_uploads_renditions_live_id.where: "master_avatar_uploads"."thumb_key" is not null and "master_avatar_uploads"."renditions_deleted_at" is null

master_avatar_uploads_upload_shape.name: master_avatar_uploads_upload_shape
master_avatar_uploads_upload_shape.value:
("master_avatar_uploads"."status" = 'awaiting_upload'
                and "master_avatar_uploads"."verified_content_type" is null
                and "master_avatar_uploads"."raw_size_bytes" is null
                and "master_avatar_uploads"."failure_code" is null)
             or ("master_avatar_uploads"."status" in ('uploaded', 'processing', 'ready')
                and "master_avatar_uploads"."verified_content_type" is not null
                and "master_avatar_uploads"."raw_size_bytes" is not null
                and "master_avatar_uploads"."raw_size_bytes" > 0
                and "master_avatar_uploads"."failure_code" is null)
             or ("master_avatar_uploads"."status" = 'failed'
                and "master_avatar_uploads"."failure_code" is not null)

master_avatar_uploads_renditions_shape.name: master_avatar_uploads_renditions_shape
master_avatar_uploads_renditions_shape.value:
("master_avatar_uploads"."thumb_key" is null) = ("master_avatar_uploads"."display_key" is null)
          and ("master_avatar_uploads"."status" <> 'ready' or "master_avatar_uploads"."thumb_key" is not null)
          and ("master_avatar_uploads"."thumb_key" is null or "master_avatar_uploads"."status" in ('processing', 'ready', 'failed'))
          and ("master_avatar_uploads"."renditions_deleted_at" is null or "master_avatar_uploads"."thumb_key" is not null)

portfolio_media_upload_shape.name: portfolio_media_upload_shape
portfolio_media_upload_shape.value:
("portfolio_media"."status" = 'awaiting_upload'
                and "portfolio_media"."verified_content_type" is null
                and "portfolio_media"."raw_size_bytes" is null
                and "portfolio_media"."failure_code" is null)
             or ("portfolio_media"."status" in ('uploaded', 'processing', 'ready')
                and "portfolio_media"."verified_content_type" is not null
                and "portfolio_media"."raw_size_bytes" is not null
                and "portfolio_media"."raw_size_bytes" > 0
                and "portfolio_media"."failure_code" is null)
             or ("portfolio_media"."status" = 'failed'
                and "portfolio_media"."failure_code" is not null)

portfolio_media_renditions_shape.name: portfolio_media_renditions_shape
portfolio_media_renditions_shape.value:
("portfolio_media"."status" = 'ready'
             and "portfolio_media"."thumb_key" is not null
             and "portfolio_media"."display_key" is not null
             and "portfolio_media"."width" is not null and "portfolio_media"."width" > 0
             and "portfolio_media"."height" is not null and "portfolio_media"."height" > 0
             and "portfolio_media"."bytes_total" is not null and "portfolio_media"."bytes_total" > 0)
          or ("portfolio_media"."status" in ('processing', 'failed')
             and ("portfolio_media"."thumb_key" is null) = ("portfolio_media"."display_key" is null)
             and "portfolio_media"."width" is null
             and "portfolio_media"."height" is null
             and "portfolio_media"."bytes_total" is null)
          or ("portfolio_media"."status" in ('awaiting_upload', 'uploaded')
             and "portfolio_media"."thumb_key" is null
             and "portfolio_media"."display_key" is null
             and "portfolio_media"."width" is null
             and "portfolio_media"."height" is null
             and "portfolio_media"."bytes_total" is null)

portfolio_posts_removed_idx.name: portfolio_posts_removed_idx
portfolio_posts_removed_idx.where: "portfolio_posts"."removed_at" is not null and "portfolio_posts"."evidence_purged_at" is null

portfolio_posts_removal_shape.name: portfolio_posts_removal_shape
portfolio_posts_removal_shape.value:
("portfolio_posts"."removed_at" is null
             and "portfolio_posts"."removed_by_admin_id" is null
             and "portfolio_posts"."removal_reason" is null)
          or ("portfolio_posts"."removed_at" is not null
             and "portfolio_posts"."removed_by_admin_id" is not null
             and "portfolio_posts"."removal_reason" is not null
             and char_length(btrim("portfolio_posts"."removal_reason")) between 1 and 600)

portfolio_posts_evidence_shape.name: portfolio_posts_evidence_shape
portfolio_posts_evidence_shape.value:
("portfolio_posts"."evidence_moved_at" is null or "portfolio_posts"."removed_at" is not null)
          and ("portfolio_posts"."evidence_purged_at" is null or "portfolio_posts"."removed_at" is not null)
          and ("portfolio_posts"."evidence_attempted_at" is null or "portfolio_posts"."removed_at" is not null)
          and ("portfolio_posts"."evidence_copied_at" is null or "portfolio_posts"."removed_at" is not null)
          and ("portfolio_posts"."evidence_moved_at" is null or "portfolio_posts"."evidence_copied_at" is not null)
